verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is itself an official CLI (`tofu`), documented at /docs/cli/ with commands such as plan, test and import. It also offers machine-readable output via -json-into, saved plan files that `tofu apply` can execute later, and many official install methods, including an OCI image. That makes it well suited to scripted and agent-driven use. Missing for 10: AI-agent-specific CLI guidance and independent hands-on corroboration of agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The `tofu plan` command creates an execution plan, which lets you preview the changes that OpenTofu plans to make to your infrastructure.
`-json-into=out.json` - Produces the same output as -json, but redirected to a file. This allows for simultaneous capture of both human readable and machine readable logs.
You can use the optional `-out=FILE` option to save the generated plan to a file on disk, which you can later execute by passing the file to `tofu apply` as an extra argument.
Use official OCI container image available on GitHub Container Registry.
